## HaloBar 0.0.8

### New
- **Album art background in the player**, with a **Strength** slider. Shared with Astraeus: flip it in either app.
- **Visualizer sensitivity.** How strongly the player's light and the dock's bars react to the music, shared with Astraeus.
- **A fuller clipboard.** Repeat counts, notes, drag items out, copy links without tracking, copy file paths, save images to Downloads, clear by time, delete after a set age, and an encrypted history. Its layout is unchanged.
- **An Advanced section** that folds open, with a card for the dock and, when they're in use, the player and the clipboard. Open the player on hover lives here too.

### Better
- **Show desktop works everywhere.** It now minimizes and restores windows itself, like Windows' own button, instead of relying on a shell command some PCs ignore.
- **Astraeus' sidebar keeps clear of the dock**, at any dock size.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
